rows.notes: [SC192 2026-11-27] Plant capacity of the built Balama operation (2 Mtpa ore, ~350 ktpa graphite) stated as retained annual capacity in the Oct 2025 press report on Syrah's Q3 2025 report. Installed = nameplate of the existing plant; the mine ran in campaign mode (zero output in Q1 2025, restart June 2025, 67 kt produced in 2025 per Syrah's page), so installed is not output. Syrah's own page (https://www.syrahresources.com.au/balama-project, undated) says 'Plant capacity: 2Mtpa ore throughput yielding ~350ktpa graphite' - not used as evidence because it carries no date.

[SC192 2026-11-27] Dongwha announced completion of the Tennessee facility on 19 Feb 2025 with 86,000 t/yr capacity (Asiae); Korea Times of 27 May 2026 says it 'currently has' 86,000 t/yr in the US. Third-party database battery-tech.net gives >70,000 t/y (not used). Mass-production start date not found; completion announcement used as the dated step.

[SC192 2026-11-27] BioBioChile 6 Oct 2026: POSCO inaugurated the second Sal de Oro plant (lithium carbonate, 23,000 t/yr) next to the existing lithium hydroxide plant (25,000 t/yr, phase 1 inaugurated Oct 2024 per other press). 48,000 = 23,000 t Li2CO3 + 25,000 t LiOH, mixed product units as in the row's capacity (IIR reports 48,000 t LCE across both phases). The article states the carbonate plant's processing capacity at inauguration, not a ramp-up level; whether it was already producing at that date is not stated, so treat as upper end of built capacity. Combined total is the sum of two stated plant capacities (article does not print 48,000). [lead] installed = 23,000 t Li2CO3 (Sal de Oro carbonate plant); the 25,000 t LiOH is the separate Güemes row and converts the same lithium.

[SC192 2026-11-27] ERG Metalkol Copper Mark self-assessment (PwC assured, assessment period to 30 Jun 2025): 'capacity to produce ~100ktpa copper cathode and ~23ktpa cobalt in hydroxide'. Operating plant (production reported by ERG); figure is the company's stated capacity, not output. Quote read from the rendered small-print page of the PDF (no text layer via fetch) - verify_quotes may not match it.

[SC192 2026-11-27] Arcadium FY2024 10-K: theoretical capacity at Fenix of 28,000 MT lithium carbonate and 9,000 MT lithium chloride (the LiCl is processed at Guemes - a separate row). Installed here = the carbonate figure only to avoid double counting with the Guemes row; the row's 40,000 t LCE plan is the expansion target. Figure is labelled 'theoretical capacity'. Rio Tinto closing of the Arcadium acquisition not checked.

[SC192 2026-11-27] Arcadium FY2024 10-K: Olaroz Stage 1 capacity 17,500 MT and Stage 2 25,000 MT lithium carbonate (100% basis); the same filing says Stage 2 was in 'ongoing production start-up' at 31 Dec 2024. Only Stage 1 (17,500) is recorded as installed and running; Stage 2's 25,000 is built but ramping and is NOT counted (no source for its commissioning date). Floor value; the row's 42,500 plan = Stage 1 + Stage 2.

[SC192 2026-11-27] Nornickel Annual Report 2019: 'Harjavalta's capacity is 66 ktpa of nickel products' (row's plan figure is 65,000 from press; 66 vs 65 kt is a minor source difference, installed left at the filing's 66,000). Dated 2019: the planned expansion to 75 ktpa (2021 announcement) is not counted as installed - no source confirming it was completed.

[SC192 2026-11-27] MinRes Wodgina page: three processing trains, total annual production capacity ~750,000 t spodumene concentrate (page states 5.5% Li2O); Q1 FY27 quarterly report (23 Oct 2026): all three trains operated continuously, record 102k dmt in the quarter. The Wodgina page carries no publication date, so installed_as_of is the date of the quarterly confirming the three trains running.

[SC192 2026-11-27] MinRes/Ganfeng Mt Marion FID release (26 May 2026): flotation plant and underground projects raise 'installed capacity from ~500ktpa SC6 to 600ktpa SC6'. Installed = ~500 ktpa SC6; the 600 ktpa in the row is the post-FID plan (not yet built). Whole-site 100% basis (MinRes 50%, Ganfeng 50%). Older MinRes material mentions 900 ktpa mixed-grade concentrate - different basis, not used.

[SC192 2026-11-27] Mining Technology (19 Nov 2024): Goro 'produces 57,000 tpa of nickel and 5,000 tpa of cobalt' and 'is designed to produce 57,000tpa of nickel' - design capacity of the built HPAL plant (commissioned 2010; restarted Dec 2024 after 7-month stoppage). Operating at less than design in 2025-26 (July 2026 tailings-dam leak curtailment per press); installed = design capacity, not output.
[SC192 2026-11-27] Same source and caveats as the Goro nickel row: 5,000 tpa cobalt design capacity of the built plant (Mining Technology, 19 Nov 2024).

[SC192 2026-11-27] Nickel 28 (8.56% holder) Q4/FY2025 release of 23 Feb 2026: Ramu design capacity 32,600 t Ni per year; calendar-2025 production 33,007 t contained nickel in MHP (above design, so the design capacity is built and running). installed_as_of = 31 Dec 2025 (period end of the production year); statement published 2026-02-23. Cobalt 3,099 t in 2025 not recorded on this nickel row.

[SC192 2026-11-27] Vale Base Metals release 30 Sep 2025: Furnace 2 began operating, bringing Onca Puma to nameplate 40 ktpa nickel (press says +15 kt from Furnace 1's 25 kt). Ramp-up of Furnace 2 after start-up not documented; installed = nameplate at the start-up date.
